root_cause.note: The parent recording task never completed, so it produced no footage and no step log. Its own log records why: the wizard happy path needs a reachable OpenWrt router with SSH, and none was reachable from the recording host. No run => no take => no probe, no step map, no scan.

corroboration.quote: D3 | Raw footage does not exist, so no plan/cut is derivable | card t_882b3922 - status ready, 2 runs, 0 completed, 0 attachments
corroboration.significance: An independent card reached the same conclusion 12 days earlier. This is a persistent chain-level stall, not a transient miss in this run.

source.note: This is the fail-closed core of the plan. No file may be named here, and no duration/resolution/fps/pix_fmt/audio/CFR-VFR value may be stated, because no file was identified as this chain's raw take. Stating null is the honest result; a numeric value here would be fabricated.

cuts.note: Head and tail trim points are defined relative to the first and last meaningful frame of a known take. With no take there is no t=0 and no EOF, so no trim point can be placed, and none may be guessed. The 0.5s-inside-the-dead-zone rule cannot be applied to an unmeasured dead zone.

step_map.note: The frame-verified step map was never produced. An empty list is deliberate: fabricating steps or timestamps would be the exact failure mode the task forbids.

validation.note: The acceptance criterion 'every step has a start and end timestamp' is satisfied only in the degenerate sense. It is NOT evidence that a usable step map exists.

flagged_interior_dead_air.note: No scan was ever run against this chain's take, so there are zero inherited regions to carry over verbatim. Nothing is flagged because nothing was measured; this must not be read as 'the take has no dead air'.

framing_anomalies.note: Not measured for this chain's take. Must not be read as 'framing is stable'.

dead_air_detection_evidence.warning: The detections below were produced by real commands, but they come from CANDIDATE-A, which is NOT this chain's source take (see candidate_footage_disposition). They are recorded to prove the detectors execute and emit real output on this host. They are explicitly NOT the plan's dead-air regions and MUST NOT be applied to any encode.

detections.reason_no_regions: This file has zero audio streams (ffprobe -select_streams a => 0), so there is no audio to analyse and silencedetect correctly emits no silence events. Recorded per the scan card's instruction to note why a detector produced nothing.

candidate_footage_disposition.note: Every video file on this host that could plausibly be mistaken for the chain's take was probed with real ffprobe and explicitly rejected. This is the diligence that makes the BLOCKED status a measured finding rather than a shrug.
